================================================================
PART C — MIGRATION STATUS  (Python 2 -> Python 3)
================================================================
All 30 Python 2-only files (Part A) have been migrated and verified.

Method:
  - 2to3/lib2to3 were unavailable on the host (Python 3.12 without the module),
    so a purpose-built, string/comment-aware migrator (/tmp/opencode/migrate_py2.py)
    applied each transformation and verified every file with `python3 -m py_compile`.
  - Indentation is preserved as-is; tabs were expanded to spaces ONLY on the 4
    files that have a genuine latent TabError (tab/space mixing that surfaces only
    after print statements are fixed). The other tab-heavy files (e.g.
    analyze_suspend.py, analyze_boot.py) keep their original tabs — no style churn.

Transformations applied (verified on disk):
  print stmt         -> print(...)                         143
  print x,           -> print(x, end=' ')  (trailing comma)   ~30
  print >> f, x      -> print(x, file=f)                   +   10
  print >> f, x,     -> print(x, end=' ', file=f)          +    1
  except E, e:       -> except E as e:                          12
  d.has_key(k)      -> k in d                                  9
  .iteritems()      -> .items()  (.iterkeys/.itervalues likewise)  5
  xrange(           -> range(                                  1
  raw_input(        -> input(                                   2
  ConfigParser.SafeConfigParser -> ConfigParser.ConfigParser   + import configparser as ConfigParser
  long(...)         -> int(...)  +  \d+L -> \d+  (e.g. 0L->0)   3+1
  lambda(k, v): (v, k) -> lambda kv: (kv[1], kv[0])            4
  `async`/`await` as identifiers -> `async_`/`await_` (Py3.7+ keyword)  (analyze_suspend.py)

Post-migration verification (on disk):
  - python3 -m py_compile  :  30/30 files compile cleanly
  - Py2 marker scan       :  0 leftover markers (string/comment-aware)
  - git diff              :  exactly 30 files changed; the 5 Py2/3-compat
                            files (kernel_headers.py, mkdtboimg.py,
                            intel_pstate_tracer.py, kfigure.py, rstFlatTable.py)
                            were intentionally NOT touched.

Files that had tabs expanded (latent TabError, tabsize=8):
  - Documentation/target/tcm_mod_builder.py
  - tools/perf/scripts/python/event_analyzing_sample.py
  - tools/perf/scripts/python/intel-pt-events.py
  - tools/perf/scripts/python/check-perf-trace.py

REMAINING (non-blocking) FOLLOW-UP — pre-existing invalid escape sequences:
  Several migrated files (notably analyze_suspend.py & analyze_boot.py) contain
  regex strings written without a raw-string prefix, e.g. re.match('\[...', ...)
  and re.match('\\+...', ...). These emit SyntaxWarning under Python 3.12
  ("invalid escape sequence") and will become hard SyntaxErrors in future
  Python (likely 3.14+). They are PRE-EXISTING (not introduced by this
  migration) and do not affect execution, but for future-proofing they should be
  converted to raw strings (r'...') or escaped. NOT done here to keep the
  migration diff focused; can be addressed as a separate pass.
